Description: All manufacturing processes for nacelle structure shall be qualified per Part 21 and internal quality standards.
Acceptance_Criteria: Process capability Cpk ≥1.33; first article inspection passed

Description: Nacelle assembly shall meet dimensional tolerances for proper fit with engine and pylon interfaces.
Acceptance_Criteria: Interface tolerances per ICD; no shimming >3mm

Description: Composite layup processes shall be controlled to ensure fiber orientation and ply thickness within allowable limits.
Bonded joints shall be manufactured with controlled surface preparation and cure cycles to ensure bond quality.
Acceptance_Criteria: NDI acceptance; lap shear specimens per batch

Description: Paint systems and surface treatments shall meet environmental protection and cosmetic requirements.
Acceptance_Criteria: Coating thickness per specification; adhesion ≥4B rating
